title: TypeSomething footer (v2)
description: A warm-grey footer: a large bold-and-lime wordmark that types itself out, with a tiny tracked tagline beneath, a few company lines and round outlined social buttons; three small-caps link columns; and a bottom bar with the copyright, underlined legal links, a 'built with' badge and a round back-to-top button. Links get a thick lime underline on hover, round buttons fill with ink.
notes: the ground is the secondary colour (a warm grey in this theme)
social icons come in as props (tabler brand icons work well)
name: typesomething-v2-footer

props.name: brand
props.type: { lead: string; tail: string; href: string; mark?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the big wordmark: bold lead + lime tail, and a mark after it

props.description: tiny tracked line under the wordmark

props.name: details
props.description: a few short lines (domain, company name)
